newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea denies beefing up military exercise.
newsitem.headline: South Korea denies beefing up military exercise.

text.p: The South Korean military on Wednesday denied stepping up military exercises and Seoul officials accused North Korea of trying to justify its huge military spendings by whipping up war threats.
Earlier on Wednesday North Korea lashed out at the United States and South Korea for what it called preparation for an attack while it was weakened by an acute food shortage.

"We had a regiment-level amphibious landing exercise yesterday as part of annual military training programmes," a South Korean navy spokesman said. A spokesman for North Korea's powerful military said in a rare public statement: "The enemies are thought to believe it is high time they made a forestalling attack since (North Korea) is temporarily suffering from repeated natural disasters and nume rous soldiers of its armed forces are engaged in farming." Government officials in Seoul said they believed the communist North wanted to blame South Korea and the United States for tensions on the Korean peninsula to distract the world from criticisms over its massive military spendings.

"The North also wants to divert public attention from its severe food shortage. The Stalinist regime needs a certain level of war threats to maintain political stability," a unification ministry official told Reuters.
